cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: The profile exhibits a continuous, shallow downward slope from the supraorbital region to the nasal bridge, with a slight concavity visible at the junction of the frontal and nasal bones before terminating at the rhinarium.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct contrast between the white fur of the chin and the dark mucosal pigmentation of the inner lower lip visible in the slightly open mouth.
